subject: Compute: v2 resource ABI plan + new-file ownership request
body:
Read HANDOFF/TASK, FRONTEND_SHADER_AUDIT, frontend_audit_001/002, corpus_001. No phone/adb/build lease used; no production edit yet.

OWNERSHIP REQUEST (root): two NEW production files under my role, because the pure descriptor packer must be shared by future render/texture work and must not be duplicated in nord2_metal_bridge.c:
  gpu/metal/tegu/nord2_compute_resources.h  (ABI structs + pure validators/packers)
  gpu/metal/tegu/nord2_compute_resources.c
plus worker test files under gpu/build/deepseek-parallel-20261025/workers/compute/. I will not touch texture_state.*, sampler_state.inc, mali_compute_compiler.* or render_encoder.inc. If denied I will keep the packer static in nord2_metal_bridge.c and mark it private.

ABI PROPOSAL (backwards compatible; v1 untouched):
1. Package: new magic TGP2/version2, 128-byte header, code follows. Fields: code_bytes, gpu_id, registers, push_words, preload, buffer_mask(8), local[3], tls, wls, resource_mask (bit0 buffers/FAU, bit1 textures, bit2 samplers, bit3 storage images), table entry counts {textures<=8,samplers<=4,images<=4}, reserved zero. tegu_pipeline_parse() keeps v1 semantics byte-identical; new tegu_pipeline_parse2()/tegu_pipeline_parse_any(). Bridge dispatches explicitly by magic/size; TGP1 path produces the same bytes/behaviour as today.
2. Dispatch: TDG2/version2 fixed wire per region: header, 8 buffer slots {token,offset,length}, 8 texture slots {token,offset,byte-span,format,dim,width,height,depth,levels,layers,samples,usage,row_stride}, 4 sampler slots (exact Metal descriptor enum state), 4 storage-image slots (same facts + read/write), 128 push bytes. Every slot validated against the retained BO before any descriptor byte is written; no arbitrary GPU address crosses the boundary. Nonzero unwritten slots refuse, never neutral-substitute.
3. Descriptor tables: SRT index1=textures 32B entries, index2=samplers, index3=storage images, matching existing graphics TEGU_MALI_GENERIC_TEXTURE_TABLE=1/SAMPLER=2. compute sets chain.resources=SRT (RESOURCE entries) and packs table bytes in the owned command BO. Need lowering ACK: mali_compute_compiler emits pan_res_handle(1|2|3, index) for Kernel texture/sampler/image accesses and emits TGP2 only when such resources exist (TGP1 for buffer-only, so existing tests stay valid). Do NOT remove the current refusal until that lands; my bridge refuses TGP2 without a complete, validated resource wire.
4. Variants/specialization: Rust v2 planner builds StageTable with BoundTexture/BoundSampler, returns set/binding -> {kind, Metal slot, table+entry, use class, read/write spans}. If plan.variant is non-empty (storage image format, srgb, etc.) it compiles the actual bound-format variant and returns variant SPIR-V + VariantKey; frontend caches by (variant key, specialization constants, bound formats) and compiles that SPIR-V. Creation-only PSO stays non-dispatchable until the bound-format variant exists.
5. Exact dispatchThreads: translator Dispatch::Threads regions each become one frontend Dispatch/job (bounded <=8); per-region group counts+push+DispatchRegion come from DispatchCommands, never a rounded grid. Uniform grids stay one job. n2mb still submits one COMPUTE_JOB per wire.
6. Lifetime/coherence: every referenced buffer/texture/image BO retained by the command; image writes marked in write_mask and conflated with sampled/read uses; textures/samplers validated for owner device at encode and revalidated at execution. Sampler state is carried exactly (filters/mip/address/border/normalize/compare/aniso/reduction/LOD clamps); unsupported combinations produce deterministic errors.

TESTS I will run (real code, host only): Rust unit tests over real corpus AIR incl. 44d4ef... accumulateKernel (sampled2D+storage2D) and buffer-only controls; C packer tests with Mesa-v9 genxml-derived golden words; n2mb fake-transport tests asserting TGP1 unchanged, TGP2 BO/span/use validation, wrong-owner/unwritten slots, clobber-free refusal; frontend host compile with existing runtime test harness. NOT hardware verified.

ACKs needed: root ownership; lowering table indices/TGP2 emission contract; textures shared packer API (prefer I call your common helper once it exists, otherwise I implement the arch9 subset in nord2_compute_resources.* and we converge later); frontend_audit review of structs/sizeof and refusal semantics. I will post a second message with exact struct offsets before coding consumers against them.
